parsed_output.final_explanation: We prioritize durability first, then quality, then lower price, and finally sustainability. LumaBook_P16 offers the highest durability (96) and top quality (100) at a very low price (₹37,000), making it the strongest candidate. Next, LumaBook_P02 has perfect durability (100) and good sustainability (81), and its price (₹67,000) is still under the ₹70,000 threshold. LumaBook_P13 follows with high durability (86), excellent quality (96), and a moderate price (₹55,000). Finally, LumaBook_P10 has solid durability (75), good quality (89), and a price of ₹57,000, which still fits the budget while adding sustainability (73).
